paragraphs.text: Innocent Chizaram Ilo is an Igbo writer from Lagos, Nigeria.

They are the winner of the 2020 Commonwealth Short Story Prize (African Region) and an Otherwise Award Nominee. Their works interrogate gender, class, politics, and sexuality. Their works have appeared on Granta, Lolwe, Isele Magazine, Fireside Magazine, Strange Horizons, Cast of Wonders, Fantasy Magazine, Reckoning Press, Overland Magazine, Al Jazera, BBC Culture, The Guardian, and elsewhere.
Innocent Chizaram Ilo contributed to the Magic Story for Strixhaven: School of Mages .
